sources.title: Federalism
sources.claim: Constitutionally divided final authority differs from revocable local delegation and confederation.

sources.title: Multiculturalism
sources.claim: Institutional accommodation of cultural difference is distinct from private tolerance and assimilation.

sources.title: Immigration
sources.claim: Moral claims to movement and state claims to exclusion require separate examination.

sources.title: Pacifism
sources.claim: Absolute and contingent objections to war differ, including over self-defense and protection of others.

sources.title: Global Justice
sources.claim: Humanitarian intervention and trade justice are separate global-justice disputes; neither follows from generic global concern.

sources.title: Philosophy of Technology
sources.claim: Evaluation of technical change considers benefits, social effects, and risks; enthusiasm is not a single philosophical system.

sources.title: Human Enhancement
sources.claim: Enhancement beyond treatment raises distinct questions of fairness, authenticity, and governance.

sources.title: Social Norms
sources.claim: The persistence of a social norm is distinct from its moral justification.

sources.title: Ayn Rand
sources.claim: Objectivism spans metaphysics, epistemology, ethics, rights, and politics; market or atheistic preferences alone are insufficient.
